parameters.query:
UPDATE payments SET status = 'CAPTURED', razorpay_payment_id = $1, webhook_verified = TRUE, updated_at = NOW() WHERE razorpay_order_id = $2;
UPDATE bookings SET booking_status = 'CONFIRMED', payment_status = 'CAPTURED' WHERE id = (SELECT booking_id FROM payments WHERE razorpay_order_id = $2);

UPDATE payments SET status = 'FAILED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE razorpay_order_id = $1;
UPDATE bookings SET booking_status = 'PAYMENT_PENDING', payment_status = 'FAILED' WHERE id = (SELECT booking_id FROM payments WHERE razorpay_order_id = $1);

UPDATE payments SET status = 'REFUNDED', refund_id = $1, refund_amount = $2, updated_at = NOW() WHERE razorpay_payment_id = $3;
UPDATE bookings SET booking_status = 'REFUNDED', payment_status = 'REFUNDED' WHERE id = (SELECT booking_id FROM payments WHERE razorpay_payment_id = $3);
